records.assetReview: Each 100 px square cell represents 1 L and each dot 1 g of tracer. Inputs have one and three dots; the two output cells contain two dots each, conserving four grams in two litres. These are counts, not molecular geometry. New tracer-flow bars 20 + 180 px at 20 px/(g/s) give 1 + 9 = 10 g/s; volume-flow bars 40 + 120 px at 40 px/(L/s) give 1 + 3 = 4 L/s. Thus 10/4 = 5/2 g/L. Full XML, all eight dots and native rendering read.
records.distractors: 4 adds concentrations without dividing by total volume. 1 or 3 copies an inlet. A simple arithmetic mean happens to work only for these equal rates.
records.manualArithmetic: In one second, 1 L at 1 g/L carries 1 g and 1 L at 3 g/L carries 3 g. Four grams in two litres give c = 2 g/L.
records.physicalAssumptions: Steady fully mixed uniform outlet, same assigned bulk density, no leakage, tracer reaction or accumulation. Solution volumes are explicitly additive. Positive Q₁,Q₂, c₁ = 1 g/L and c₂ = 3 g/L imply strict 1 < c < 3 g/L. Tracer conservation is distinct from bulk-fluid conservation; concentration averages use the requested statistical weights.
